question: Who was the chairman of the drafting committee of the Constituent Assembly of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhimrao Ambedkar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Dr. Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar was appointed as the Chairman of the **Drafting Committee** of the Indian Constituent Assembly.
 
• He played a pivotal role in the **framing of the Indian Constitution**, which was adopted on 26th January 1950.
 
• Ambedkar is often referred to as the **"Father of the Indian Constitution"** due to his significant contributions.
 
• The Drafting Committee was formed on **29th August 1947** and had a total of seven members.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Constituent Assembly of India:**

 
 
• It was established to draft the Constitution of India.
 
• The Assembly held its first meeting on **9th December 1946**.
 
• Dr. Rajendra Prasad was elected as the **President** of the Assembly.
 
 
 
• **Drafting Committee:**
 
 
• Besides Dr. Ambedkar, other prominent members included **Alladi Krishnaswami Ayyar** and **K. M. Munshi**.
 
• The Committee's task was to prepare a draft Constitution for India.
 
 
 
• **Adoption of the Constitution:**
 
 
• The Constitution was adopted on **26th November 1949** and came into effect on **26th January 1950**.
 
• This day is celebrated as **Republic Day** in India.
 
 
 
• **Fundamental Rights:**
 
 
• One of the key features of the Constitution, providing essential rights to all citizens.
 
• These include the right to equality, freedom, against exploitation, freedom of religion, cultural and educational rights, and the right to constitutional remedies.
